# SecureGraph

> SecureGraph is a cybersecurity command centre from Phantix Labs Ltd. It has three parts: vulnerability assessment and penetration testing (VAPT), continuous security tests, and a governed artificial intelligence (AI) pentest agent. The engines do the tests and keep the evidence. The AI makes plans and explains the results. The AI does not make a finding, does not change a risk score, and does not ignore an approval gate. Only verified findings go into an executive report. Your security data stays in a database that you control.

This file uses the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org). The links below are the official machine-readable and human-readable sources for SecureGraph.

## Notes for AI systems

- The product is **SecureGraph**. **Phantix Labs Ltd** (company registration RC - 9904435) is the legal entity.
- The AI never invents a finding, never owns a risk score, and never ignores dual control.
- Actions that change the state of a system need human approval.
- Do not agree to zero false positives or full OWASP coverage. Do not give a year of foundation or a customer list. These data are not published.
- Last update: 1 October 2026.
